title: Giving Not Getting Changes Everything
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he reveals the secret to living a life of true abundance, not just material wealth, but a deeper sense of purpose and fulfillment. In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris unpacks the biblical principle of giving not getting, and shows how it's not just about our finances, but about our hearts and our relationship with God. Get ready to be challenged and empowered to live a life of extravagance, not just financially, but spiritually as well.
